_ARCHIVED_SNAPSHOT: NOT THE RUNTIME RULE PACK. This is a frozen blueprint copy kept only so the project could be rebuilt from zero; it is not imported, built, tested or served by anything, and it has NOT been kept in step with the live packs. The authoritative pack this file is a stale copy of lives at pathwise-app/lib/rulepacks/va-aid.json. Read that one. Any verified_on date below describes the snapshot as it stood when it was taken, not a verification of this file.
authority: SCHEV VASA guidance; Federal Student Aid (FAFSA)

volatility.note: State aid application landscape changing; re-verify VASA rules and dates before submission.

form_selection.rule: Students eligible for FAFSA should file FAFSA (covers both federal and state aid). VASA is for students who cannot file FAFSA (e.g., undocumented / tuition-equity students).

fafsa_blocks.headline: F-1 status blocks Virginia state financial aid

va_student_provisions.note: Qualifies via VA domicile (see va-domicile pack).
Qualifies as a dependent of military personnel stationed in VA.

deadlines.rule: A student's true deadline is the EARLIEST of {college priority date, state deadline, federal deadline}. Surface the earliest, not the federal fallback.
deadlines.cite: SCHEV VASA guidance; institutional priority dates

confidentiality.note: Campuses are legally prohibited from sharing VASA application information for immigration enforcement.
confidentiality.product_consequence: Underpins the no-account / no-store privacy posture.
